summary:
Frontend-only test of the About the Group paragraphs after the animation was removed. The paragraphs are plain

elements (opacity 1, transform none, filter none, parent opacity 1, justify alignment, bold/italic/colour spans rendered, no ** or [c= markers). Every normal run passed with CMS text 'Our strength is built on...'. Desktop 1920x800: 10/10 reloads (4 with localStorage cleared), visible in 47-238ms. Home -> navbar ABOUT (client-side) 3/3 in 30-100ms, back/forward 3/3 in about 20ms. Mobile 390x844: 5/5 reloads (2 cleared), 66-148ms. Admin Content > About Page > Tentang Kami > Tampilan asli: iframe /about shows both paragraphs with CMS text. Simulated network faults with no cache: a 4s slow /api/content shows CMS text after about 4.5s; an aborted /api/content falls back to the bundled default 'Our approach...'; a HANGING /api/content leaves the paragraphs missing for good (0

after 12s). The 11th desktop reload hit the preview Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' challenge, which is infra rate limiting, not an app bug.

ui_bugs.issue: First visit (no sunjaya_content_v1 cache) while GET /api/content stalls: axios.get has no timeout, so the finally block never runs, contentReady stays false and About.jsx renders no paragraphs ((contentReady ? bodyParas : [])). Reproduced in Playwright by holding /api/content open for 20s: 0 about-para elements after 12s. This is the likely real-world cause of 'never appears, refresh again and again'. A refresh only helps once a request succeeds and the cache is filled.

integration_issues.issue: When /api/content fails (abort/network error), the paragraphs show the old bundled default 'Founded in Indonesia on May 20, 2013... / Our approach is simple...' instead of the CMS text. This is expected fallback behaviour, but ABOUT_TEXT/translations defaults are out of date compared with the CMS.

issues: Justify alignment on the narrow column creates large word gaps (e.g. 'Founded   in   Indonesia   in   2013'). Consider left-align on mobile.

The title above the paragraphs (LineReveal) is still animated. The screenshot caught it half-revealed/clipped ('From conventional roots...'), so the same 'slow to appear' complaint may come up for the title.

action_items: Add a timeout to the content fetch in LanguageContext.jsx (e.g. axios.get(url, {timeout: 6000})) and/or a fallback timer that sets contentReady=true after ~3-5s, so the paragraphs always render even when the API stalls on a first visit.
Update the bundled defaults for about.body1/about.body2 (aboutDefaults/translations) to match the current CMS text, so the fallback does not show the old 'Our approach' copy.
Optional: remove/soften the LineReveal animation on the About title as well; consider left alignment for the paragraphs on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext.jsx line 40: axios.get without a timeout combined with gating on contentReady means a stalled request leaves the paragraphs missing indefinitely.
LanguageContext.jsx line 25: the cached JSON is re-parsed from localStorage on every render (the IIFE runs on every render, not only at init). Move it into a useState initializer or useMemo.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for normal-network scenarios (21/21 loads). Fails only in the simulated hanging-API/no-cache scenario

seed_data_creation: None. No content data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: About paragraphs: [data-testid=about-para-0/1] (desktop) and about-para-mobile-0/1. Navbar link: [data-testid=nav-link-about]. Admin: #admin-tab-content > #content-page-about-toggle > #content-section-about-toggle > 'Tampilan asli' button; the preview iframe URL is /about. Preview Cloudflare blocks after ~11 rapid reloads, so split reload loops across sessions. To test the hang case: localStorage.clear() and page.route('**/api/content') with a delay that never resolves.
